definitions: To introduce again; to bring back into use, existence, or a place.
To present again for consideration or discussion.
examples: The species was reintroduced to its natural habitat.
The bill was reintroduced in the new legislative session.
He reintroduced the topic later in the meeting.
pastTenses: reintroduced (simple past), reintroduced (present perfect), reintroduced (past perfect)
